basis: assembled pinned source packet and current code inspection; no new PDF inspection or independent scientific signature

rows.finding: Selected BK2022v1 author preprint supplies Hooke elasticity, constant Tresca set and normal-cone flow. The discrete BE projection is project-derived; it must not be attributed to a printed source algorithm.

Host sigma=-tau, de=-delta epsilon and ep=-epsilon_p preserve centrally symmetric yield set, isotropic elasticity, normal cone and plastic work. Explicit total Cauchy, Mandel, small strain, fixed frame and objective_rate none.
Strict positive lambda, mu and k preserve the selected source range. p_ref is a positive numerical scale. Defaults are examples; parameters are not calibrated. Uniaxial yield width is 2k.

Both sigma6 and ep6 are required explicitly. Compatible initial total strain is implied by ep plus elastic compliance of sigma; laboratory strain is change from preparation. No clock, density, creep or reversal reset exists.

New ep residual subtracts C^-1 times the stress residual from the original ep row. The block row transformation is invertible, preserves physical roots, and changes off-root current-state derivatives. Pressure-preserved returned stress permits the split deviator formula. Transformed independent references cover all 38 columns.

Certified predicates preserve source strict corner inequalities; true face/corner equality remains face, true yield equality elastic. AD is a selected branch extension, not a unique tangent at nonsmooth boundaries. Selected projectors must remain isolated.
